english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning these Names: God, Rich One, and Angel; who they are.
english_classification.chapter_note: A remarkably clean substrate chapter. The teaching is a systematic three-fold emanation hierarchy (gods, rich ones, angels) mapped across three domains: eternal archetypes, cosmic agents in the contest, and eschatological households. Both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system throughout. The only non-substrate material is dialogue frame attribution (¶2 fully, and frame formulas in ¶1, ¶3, ¶7, ¶10). No editorial bridge, no exhortation, no institutional extension. The seam flag on ¶10 is a false positive — the third application maps to cosmic households (Great Spirit, Beloved of the Lights, Ambassador), not to institutional structures. The order shift in the third application (god→angel→rich instead of god→rich→angel) may reflect intentional mapping to three emanation series (descent, creation, redemption). Teaching purity is high and editorial fatigue is minimal.
